<template>
	<AsamTreeSelect
		:check-strictly="false"
		value-mode="native"
		v-model="value"
		:data="data"
		filterable
		style="width: 240px"
	/>
	<AsamDivider />
	筛选方法：
	<AsamTreeSelect
		:check-strictly="false"
		value-mode="native"
		v-model="value"
		:data="data"
		:filter-method="filterMethod"
		filterable
		style="width: 240px"
	/>
	<AsamDivider />
	节点筛选方法：
	<AsamTreeSelect
		:check-strictly="false"
		value-mode="native"
		v-model="value"
		:data="data"
		:filter-node-method="filterNodeMethod"
		filterable
		style="width: 240px"
	/>
</template>

<script setup>


import { AsamTreeSelect, AsamDivider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree-select/filterable.vue
import { ref } from 'vue';
const value = ref();
const sourceData = [
	{
		value: '1',
		label: '一级节点 1',
		children: [
			{
				value: '1-1',
				label: '二级节点 1-1',
				children: [
					{
						value: '1-1-1',
						label: '三级节点 1-1-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		value: '2',
		label: '一级节点 2',
		children: [
			{
				value: '2-1',
				label: '二级节点 2-1',
				children: [
					{
						value: '2-1-1',
						label: '三级节点 2-1-1'
					}
				]
			},
			{
				value: '2-2',
				label: '二级节点 2-2',
				children: [
					{
						value: '2-2-1',
						label: '三级节点 2-2-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		value: '3',
		label: '一级节点 3',
		children: [
			{
				value: '3-1',
				label: '二级节点 3-1',
				children: [
					{
						value: '3-1-1',
						label: '三级节点 3-1-1'
					}
				]
			},
			{
				value: '3-2',
				label: '二级节点 3-2',
				children: [
					{
						value: '3-2-1',
						label: '三级节点 3-2-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	}
];
const data = ref(sourceData);
const filterMethod = (value) => {
	data.value = [...sourceData].filter((item) => item.label.includes(value));
};
const filterNodeMethod = (value, data) => String(data.label).includes(String(value));
</script>
